references.label: Two 10-point top rollovers
references.description: Upper lanes that each add 10 to the player's card score.

references.label: Center 1-point switches
references.description: Central bumper and standup target that each add one point to the hand.

references.label: Left and right card-value ejects
references.description: Side eject holes that add the card currently lit on their side.

references.label: Card-selection advance rollovers
references.description: Rollover switches that rotate the lit card value available at the ejects and outlanes.

references.label: Bust recovery gate
references.description: Right-side gate opened after the player's score exceeds 21, allowing a possible shooter-lane recovery.
